issues.title: Refresh joyful Bluey mascot across Flutter and website

criteria.requirement: Default Flutter FaceScreen renders the joyful bird and follows mood and gaze

tests.name: new joyful mascot is the default on every screen size

criteria.requirement: Reduced-motion preferences suppress idle movement without suppressing speech state

tests.name: reduced motion freezes the mascot animation

criteria.requirement: Four CI Flutter render artifacts are available at platform viewport dimensions
criteria.reason: The macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android viewport artifacts are published by the preview workflow and require visual review; they are not native-device evidence.

criteria.requirement: Website and README use the bird and preserve accurate platform disclosures
criteria.reason: Website browser tests and README screenshots run independently; generated art and marketing copy still require reviewer approval.

criteria.requirement: Native builds and real hardware behavior validated before issue closure
criteria.reason: Builds run on hosted CI but physical macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android device validation is not yet complete; Linux remains an unsupported host/client.
